philippians.1.p1.b1.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus,

philippians.1.p1.b2.text: To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

philippians.1.p2.b1.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

philippians.1.p2.b2.text: I thank my God every time I remember you. In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,

philippians.1.p3.b1.text: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

philippians.1.p3.b2.text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

philippians.1.p3.b3.text: … since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

philippians.1.p4.b1.text: … how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

philippians.1.p4.b2.text: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

philippians.1.p4.b3.text: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

philippians.1.p5.b1.text: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.

philippians.1.p5.b2.text: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

philippians.1.p5.b3.text: … most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.

philippians.1.p6.b1.text: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

philippians.1.p6.b2.text: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.

philippians.1.p6.b3.text: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,

philippians.1.p7.b1.text: … so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.

philippians.1.p7.b2.text: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

philippians.1.p7.b3.text: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.

philippians.1.p7.b4.text: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.

philippians.1.p8.b1.text: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.

philippians.1.p8.b2.text: … I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,

philippians.1.p8.b3.text: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had,

philippians.1.p8.b4.text: and now hear that I still have.
